newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: European feeds start lower but quiet.
newsitem.headline: European feeds start lower but quiet.

text.p: European meals and feed were offered at lower levels in early business on Thursday but many players remained nervous after Chicago's movements yesterday and there were no initial trades.
"After a move like that, when the market is nervous and hectic, we made a typical start -- quiet," one trader said.
Sellers offered soymeal around a dollar lower but failed to solicit any bids from consumers, who were still waiting for rain forecasts to take the heat out of the Chicago futures.
Other prices were mostly unchanged from Wednesday.
